answer_burst.description: Signed answers each controller may hold unspent.

answer_rate.description: Signed answers each controller regains a second (imbu's answer budget).

clients.description: How many controllers each home serves, each with its own key and connection pool.

homes.description: How many imbu issuers, each its own home and process, share the deployment (this.i 2lkqz9mq).

operation_timeout_s.description: How long an operation may run before the adapter gives up on it.

poll_ms.description: How often the adapter reads an operation until it finishes; the milestone times come from imbu, not from this poll. n/a when the adapter waits instead.

signer.description: lockbox: the principal's keys are in the lockbox; external: heti's ThrottledSigner holds them (this.i 2p26rn9h).

signer_latency_ms.description: The external signer's latency per operation.

signer_rate.description: The external signer's cap on operation starts per second.

toad.description: Witness receipts imbu requires before an event is settled.

wait_s.description: Prefer: wait sent on each request and operation read, so imbu answers once the operation settles; n/a when the adapter polls.

delivery_timeout_s.description: How long the Registrar waits on a subscriber.

resync_s.description: How often the Observer resynchronizes; must exceed the window.

deadline_s.description: How long verification is retried before the credential counts as not verified.

freshness_s.description: How old the Observer's state may be before the verifier refuses to rely on it.

retry_ms.description: How soon a refused verification is tried again.

count.description: How many witnesses the pool runs.

scenario:
# bench-stock: office-day-3homes with one of three witnesses killed for 25 minutes, an hour in,
# and the window cut to 9,000 s (this.i 7wvv745c). Needs `uv sync --extra stacks`. Every other
# size is office-day-3homes's, this.i under 4j5395l8.
scenario_schema = 1
name = "office-day-3homes-witness-outage"
description = "A witness outage: 0.35 a second at three homes for 9,000 s, with witness_pool.w0 killed at 3,600 s and restarted 1,500 s later; every 101st credential is delivered, verified and revoked."
stages = ["issue", "deliver", "present", "verify", "revoke"]

[recognition]
poll_ms = 10000.0
stable_polls = 2

[lifecycle]
full_every = 101

[load]
rates = [0.35]
duration_s = 9000.0
warmup_s = 0.0
drain_s = 2400.0
repetitions = 3
measure = ["requested", "witnessed"]

[statistics]
lag_limit_ms = 25.0

[soak]
bucket = 200
per_credentials = 1000
sample_s = 120.0

[stop]
credentials = 10000

[roles.witness_pool]
adapter = "heti.witness_pool"
[roles.witness_pool.knobs]
knob_schema = 1
count = 3

[roles.state_distribution]
adapter = "registrar.state_distribution"
[roles.state_distribution.knobs]
knob_schema = 1
window_s = 900.0
delivery_timeout_s = 450.0
resync_s = 2700.0

[roles.issuer]
adapter = "imbu.issuer"
[roles.issuer.knobs]
knob_schema = 4
toad = 2
poll_ms = "n/a"
wait_s = 25.0
answer_rate = 2.0
answer_burst = 20
operation_timeout_s = 60.0
homes = 3
clients = 4
signer = "lockbox"
signer_latency_ms = "n/a"
signer_rate = "n/a"

[roles.holder]
adapter = "heti.holder"
[roles.holder.knobs]
knob_schema = 1
toad = 2

[roles.verifier]
adapter = "heti.verifier"
[roles.verifier.knobs]
knob_schema = 1
toad = 2
freshness_s = 900.0
retry_ms = 5000.0
deadline_s = 1200.0

[[faults]]
kind = "crash"
target = "witness_pool.w0"
at_s = 3600.0
duration_s = 1500.0
